rules.title: Advance payment protection
rules.applies_when: Any payment is due before objective delivery and acceptance.
rules.preferred_position: No advance payment; pay after documented acceptance and valid invoice.
fallback_positions: A capped advance supported by an approved bank guarantee or escrow arrangement.

rules.title: Automatic renewal control
rules.preferred_position: Renewal requires affirmative written approval before the current term ends.
fallback_positions: Auto-renewal with at least 60 days' notice and a named renewal owner.
